order_raw:
1. Focused neurologic examination including assessment of tremor at rest and with posture/action, handwriting and spiral drawing, finger-to-nose testing, tone, bradykinesia, gait, and postural stability
2. Complete blood count
3. Comprehensive metabolic panel, including calcium and liver and kidney function
4. Thyroid-stimulating hormone and free thyroxine
5. Serum vitamin B12 level
6. Serum ceruloplasmin and 24-hour urinary copper
7. Brain MRI without contrast
dx: Idiopathic Parkinson disease (early asymmetric akinetic-rigid parkinsonism with predominantly postural tremor)
